items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had played with Basie and his brother was Ernie Wilkins.

ctx.x: How was this received in the community?

No gigs came from it but we did have a few ballrooms and stuff like that. Then, another guy came to town with the Basie influence thing. He had played with Basie and his brother was Ernie Wilkins. He played trombone with the band at one time. They had a little money so they could spend the time and stuff there. He went on and kept a band in Detroit, that’s where us and all of the young guys…we had a thirst for it so every Monday and Thursday we would practice with that band. Saturday afternoon was Barry Harris…
